01

Setting specification

Task

Compute $C=AB$ exactly.

Admissible model

Assume $A\in\mathbb{F}^{\lceil n^a\rceil\times\lceil n^b\rceil}$ and $B\in\mathbb{F}^{\lceil n^b\rceil\times\lceil n^c\rceil}$. The field $\mathbb{F}$ and real shape exponents $a\ge b\ge c>0$ are fixed in advance, with $n\to\infty$.

Oracle interface

All input entries are supplied as exact field elements, with no hidden-matrix query interface. Addition, subtraction, and multiplication over the public field have unit arithmetic cost; associated preprocessing cannot be hidden for free.

Output

Return every entry of the product $C$ exactly for all inputs.

Loss or accuracy criterion

The base loss is $\mathbf1\{\widehat C\ne AB\}$ and must always be zero. Native complexity is the infimum exponent of exact arithmetic work.

Resource accounting

Count field additions, subtractions, and multiplications, not bit operations. Preprocessing and internal algebra use the same cost unit. Field-element encoding length and communication scalarization are unspecified.

Algorithm views and success guarantees

Algorithms are deterministic and use exact field arithmetic. General algorithm design, recursion, and preprocessing are allowed, but every field operation is charged. Communication and memory have no separate budgets. This arithmetic model is not replaced by an exact-real oracle model.

The output is exact for every input. The exponent describes worst-case work as n tends to infinity over a fixed field, with shape exponents also fixed in the rectangular case. No probabilistic success quantifier is involved.

Budget convention
Worst-case arithmetic count at each $n$, followed by the infimum asymptotic exponent as $n\to\infty$.

Notation and parameters

$\mathbb F$

The field fixed throughout the asymptotic matrix-multiplication problem.

Domain
Any field, including a finite field.
$n$

The base asymptotic scale for matrix dimensions.

Domain
$n\in\mathbb N,\ n\to\infty$
$a$

Exponent of the row dimension of the first input matrix

Domain
$a\ge b\ge c>0$, all fixed before $n$

$A\in\mathbb F^{\lceil n^a\rceil\times\lceil n^b\rceil}$

$b$

The exponent of the shared inner dimension of the input matrices.

Domain
$a\ge b\ge c>0$, all fixed before $n$

The column count of $A$ and row count of $B$ are both $\lceil n^b\rceil$.

$c$

The column-dimension exponent of the second input matrix.

Domain
$a\ge b\ge c>0$, all fixed before $n$

$B\in\mathbb F^{\lceil n^b\rceil\times\lceil n^c\rceil}$

$A,B$

The two fully explicit input matrices.

Domain
$A\in\mathbb F^{\lceil n^a\rceil\times\lceil n^b\rceil},\ B\in\mathbb F^{\lceil n^b\rceil\times\lceil n^c\rceil}$
$C$

The matrix product that must be returned exactly.

Domain
$\mathbb F^{\lceil n^a\rceil\times\lceil n^c\rceil}$

$C=AB$

$\langle r,s,t\rangle$

Bilinear tensor describing multiplication of an r-by-s matrix by an s-by-t matrix

Domain
$r,s,t\in\mathbb N$
$R_{\mathbb F}(\mathcal T)$

Tensor rank over the field F.

Domain
Nonnegative integer

$R_{\mathbb F}(\mathcal T)=\min\{R:\mathcal T=\sum_{i=1}^{R}u_i\otimes v_i\otimes w_i\}$

$T_{\mathbb F}(n)$

Worst-input field-operation count for the shape indexed by n.

Domain
Addition, subtraction, and multiplication each have unit cost
$\omega_{\mathbb F}(a,b,c)$

Infimum field-arithmetic exponent for matrix multiplication of this shape

Domain
Real number

$\inf\{\rho:R_{\mathbb F}(\langle\lceil n^a\rceil,\lceil n^b\rceil,\lceil n^c\rceil\rangle)=O(n^\rho)\}$

$\zeta$

Arbitrary fixed positive slack allowed when translating the infimum exponent into an operation count

Domain
$\zeta>0$

$T_{\mathbb F}(n)=O_\zeta(n^{\omega+\zeta})$

$\rho$

Candidate real exponent over which the defining infimum is taken

Domain
$\rho\in\mathbb R$
$O,\Omega,\Theta$

Upper, lower, and two-sided bounds up to constants in the same applicable regime

Domain
Hidden constants have only the parameter dependence explicitly permitted by the associated bound.

Compared quantities and resource definitions

Q1 · asymptotic exponent

\[\omega_{\mathbb F}(a,b,c)=\inf\{\rho:R_{\mathbb F}(\langle\lceil n^a\rceil,\lceil n^b\rceil,\lceil n^c\rceil\rangle)=O(n^\rho)\}\]
Scope
Fix the computational field first. In the rectangular case, also fix $a,b,c$ before taking $n\to\infty$. The infimum exponent yields an arithmetic-work bound for every fixed positive slack.
